# Echo inventory (line-edit Stage 0 harvest)

*Generated by `tools/echo_harvest.py` over 74 scene files (~229,047 words). Mechanical and over-inclusive by design — every item is a candidate, not a finding. Whether an echo is a seeded thread (PROTECTED), an accident (FIX-AT), or noise (IGNORE) is an authorial ruling recorded in `audits/line-edit/echo-rulings.md`; this file regenerates and holds no decisions.*

## 4. Within-chapter echoes (49 candidates)

Phrases repeated ≥3× inside a single chapter, scored `local / (1 + uses elsewhere)` ≥1.5 so ambient texture drops out and distinctive-and-concentrated rises. `Closest` is the smallest word-gap between two uses — a tight gap is a cluster the ear catches; a wide one may be a deliberate bookend. Sections 1–3 require an echo to cross a chapter boundary and are blind to this case.
